definitions.explanation: A performer's very first appearance on stage, or more broadly, someone's first time doing something in a public or prominent setting.

examples.japanese: {五歳|ごさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{初舞台|はつぶたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}んだ→踏む：01197_fumu⟧。
examples.english: She made her stage debut at age five.

examples.japanese: {初舞台|はつぶたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{震|ふる}えた→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
examples.english: On my first stage appearance, my legs were shaking with nervousness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初舞台|はつぶたい}にもかかわらず⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧とした⟦{演技|えんぎ}→演技：01890_engi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{魅了|みりょう}した→魅了する：19016_miryousuru⟧。
examples.english: Despite it being his debut, he gave a commanding performance that captivated the audience.

notes:
USAGE:
The most common expression is {初舞台|はつぶたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ (literally, to step on one's first stage). This is the standard way to say "to make one's debut performance." Can also be used figuratively for any first-time public appearance or first attempt in a new arena.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初舞台|はつぶたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧ (to make one's stage debut)
- {初舞台|はつぶたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧ (to mark one's debut)
- {初舞台|はつぶたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧ (memories of one's debut)
